# Citro

> Citro is AI citation intelligence. It shows whether AI platforms recommend your brand when buyers ask what to buy or who to hire, and gives a 30 to 90 day plan to improve. The core metric is the Citro Score, your citation rate across 5 AI platforms: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Grok. Powered by RootPartners.

Citro is built for small and mid-sized businesses with small marketing teams (and the agencies and founders who support them) who need to know whether they appear when buyers ask AI for vendor and product recommendations, and how to improve. It is not a generalized ranking or keyword tool and not a passive mention monitor. It does three things: it builds editable buyer personas specific to your company and asks the AI the questions those buyers actually ask; it audits where you rank and get recommended across the major AI platforms, compared to your named competitors; and it returns a specific action plan built from your own website, code, industry, and market, sequenced over 30 to 90 days.

## Product
- [How it works](https://getcitro.ai/#how-it-works): Profile your company, build buyer personas, run live, web-enabled queries across 5 AI platforms, get a Citro Score and a 90-day plan.
- [Free AI visibility check](https://getcitro.ai/free-check.html): Free, no card. Asks ChatGPT and Google Gemini three buyer questions with live web search and shows whether they recommend your business, who they name instead, and which sites they read.
- [Plans and pricing](https://getcitro.ai/plans.html): Professional is 119 USD per month with a 7-day free trial. Enterprise is 299 USD per month for up to 10 brands.
- [Sample audit report](https://getcitro.ai/sample-audit.html): An example AI Visibility Report.
- [Start a free trial](https://getcitro.ai/start.html): Run your own Citro audit.
- [FAQ](https://getcitro.ai/faq.html): How the audit works, how the Citro Score is calculated, pricing, the trial, and comparisons.
- [Full text for AI](https://getcitro.ai/llms-full.txt): This file plus the full FAQ and comparison summaries.
